data.name: Lalitaditya
data.gender_notes: Lalitaditya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lalita: lovely, pleasing to the senses; Ditya: god. This name signifies a god who is pleasing and lovely. The name Lalitaditya carries the meaning “Lovely God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lalitaditya usually hope their child will grow to embody lovely god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lalitaditya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lovely God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lalitaditya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_tamil.name: லலிததிட்ய

data.cultural_impact: Lalitaditya was an ancient king of the Shaka dynasty who ruled over present-day Karnataka, India, around 735 CE. He is considered a great ruler and military commander in Hindu mythology and history. His name, Lalitaditya, reflects the cultural significance of divine kingship in ancient India. Kings were believed to be gods on earth, and their actions and decisions were thought to have spiritual and social consequences for their people. Lalitaditya's name highlights the artistic, pleasant, and divine qualities expected of a ruler, emphasizing the importance of beauty, grace, and divine inspiration in governance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lalitaditya signifies a deity who embodies beauty and grace. In Hinduism, gods and goddesses represent various aspects of consciousness and creation. Lalitaditya's name suggests that this god is adorned with lovely, pleasing qualities. This name also represents the divine masculinity and rulership associated with Hindu deities, emphasizing the connection between the divine and human spheres. In the spiritual context, the name Lalitaditya signifies the beauty, creativity, and inspiration present in the divine realm, which shapes the human experience of the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lalitaditya signifies 'the playful God of Dharma'. His name symbolizes the divine display of cosmic order through playful actions, embodying the essence of divine grace and duty.

vedic_reference.note: Lalitaditya is a famous king mentioned in Indian History and Mythology. He is known as Lalitaditya Srivastava in Indian History and Mythology. He was a great king of the Chalukya Dynasty in Karnataka, India. He ruled during the 7th and 8th centuries CE. He is known for his military conquests and his patronage of arts, literature, and education.

historical_references.reference: Lalitaditya was a powerful ruler of the early Chalukya Dynasty in Karnataka, India. He ruled from 754 to 765 CE and is best known for his military conquests and the patronage of art and learning.

Lalitaditya, also known as Lalitaditya Munjar I, was a ruler of the Western Chalukya Empire in India. He ruled around the 12th century CE and is known for his military campaigns against the Hoysalas and the Cholas, as well as his patronage of literature and art.
